display.purpose: Hero identity and large route labels only.

body.purpose: Short supporting copy with a maximum 70-character measure.

label.purpose: Navigation metadata only, never explanatory paragraphs.

shadows.name: paper-float
shadows.purpose: Depth for a real overlapping paper sheet only.

motion.name: reveal-standard
motion.purpose: Default short reveal for structural elements.

motion.name: hero-sequence
motion.purpose: Ordered entrance for frame, greeting, identity, and routes.

motion.name: welcome-loop
motion.value: GSAP masked vertical crossfade, 700ms transition, 1800-2400ms hold
motion.purpose: Data-driven multilingual greeting slot; no visible language is a permanent hard-coded headline.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No translation or parallax when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Archive Navigation Link
components.description: Compact route link with restrained focus and hover feedback.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: var(--color-ink-soft, #6e706a); padding: 12px 8px; font: 400 12px/1.35 var(--font-mono, monospace); letter-spacing: .12em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #1d1d1a); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: var(--color-ink, #1d1d1a); outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #64745d); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Hero Route
components.description: Full-width destination row that becomes the primary homepage interaction.
components.css: .ds-hero-route { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 64px; padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d8d2c7); color: var(--color-ink, #1d1d1a); background: transparent; font: 600 48px/.95 var(--font-serif, serif); text-decoration: none; transition: color 220ms ease, padding 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-hero-route:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #64745d); padding-left: 8px; } .ds-hero-route:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #64745d); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Paper Note
components.description: A square-edged sheet used only when content genuinely behaves like a document.
components.css: .ds-paper-note { display: grid; gap: 48px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d8d2c7); color: var(--color-ink, #1d1d1a); background: var(--color-surface, #faf8f3); box-shadow: 0 1.3rem 3.5rem rgba(29,29,26,.08); } .ds-paper-note small { color: var(--color-ink-soft, #6e706a); font: 400 12px/1.35 var(--font-mono, monospace); letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-paper-note strong { font: 600 28px/1.05 var(--font-serif, serif); } .ds-paper-note:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #64745d); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: The interface feels like entering a carefully kept personal archive in soft daylight. The surface is warm and tactile, but the structure is exact. The homepage is a threshold into Richard's work and thinking, not a document about him.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, dark ink, and low-saturation accents.
Serif scale for identity, sans for clarity, mono only for compact navigation metadata.
Flat structure with paper depth used only where it communicates layering.

rules.name: The Sparse Accent Rule
rules.body: Quiet Sage and Clay Mark together occupy less than ten percent of a viewport. Their rarity gives interaction meaning.

rules.name: The One Sentence Rule
rules.body: The homepage may carry one stable identity line. Additional explanation belongs on About.

rules.name: The Flat Rest Rule
rules.body: Interactive routes remain flat at rest; motion and color indicate state before shadow does.

dos: Do preserve Archive Paper, Carbon Ink, Quiet Sage, and Clay Mark as the recognizable palette.
Do let alignment, spacing, and timing establish hierarchy before adding decoration.
Do use one GSAP timeline for the opening sequence and direct route-transition timelines for navigation.
Do keep every navigation target keyboard accessible with a visible focus state.
Do keep the first viewport complete at common laptop and mobile heights.
donts: Don't use Codex 式大量注释性文字、解释性标签和界面内说明。
Don't turn the personal homepage into a long product document or feature inventory.
Don't use repeated full-screen introduction sections, metric cards, decorative numbered scaffolding, or identical card grids.
Don't use fast flashing, bounce, elastic easing, aggressive parallax, gradient text, or default glassmorphism.
Don't use mono typography as a costume for technical credibility.
Don't hide content by default when animation fails or reduced motion is enabled.
